Disease and Poison Resistance 28.9 = (16765 + 2310 Resist Affliction) / 660. Critical Healing 25 = Dexterity 6 + Fighting Finesse 8 + The Shadow 11. Block Mitigation 55 = 50 x 1.04 + 3 heavy pieces. Resistances 70 high in the engine, exactly 4% of a medium head or shoulder piece (1754), as if one Roksa piece were purple. Update 2026-09-19: with the tooltip armor values resistances read 72 high in the engine, 4% of one medium big piece (1823), so the shoulders or the feet are likely purple; to confirm. Update 2026-09-19: the Prismatic Recovery glyph is 84 per recovery (tooltip image on file), and this sheet shows none of it from ring1, so ring1 most likely carries a glyph with no main sheet stat (Reduce Skill Cost, 133, is in the same image); the build keeps the exported Prismatic Recovery until the user confirms, and the three recovery rows read 84 x percent high in the engine meanwhile. Champion Points photo (2026-09-19, photos/tooltip-templar-cp-fitness-expert-evasion.jpg): Fitness constellation with Expert Evasion slotted at 50 of 50 stages, tooltip "Your next Roll Dodge is free of cost. After consuming this effect, you cannot gain it again for 30 seconds." (matches tables/uesp_Online_Champion_t16.csv row 'Expert Evasion'); the Fitness counter reads 62, so 62 Fitness points were unspent at the time, consistent with Sprinter not taken (championPoints.notTaken).
